definition: An organized network serving senior leaders through recurring peer interaction, shared professional context, or structured programming.
A recurring group designed for chief executives to discuss decisions and operating challenges with other CEOs.
Enterprise software whose documented primary users or buyers include finance leaders and their organizations.
Policies, responsibilities, controls, and evidence used to direct and oversee artificial-intelligence systems.
Professional recruitment focused on senior leadership and board appointments.
A bank with documented products or teams serving venture-backed companies and their investors.
Non-bank lending strategies that provide privately negotiated debt capital to companies or financial sponsors.
A professional network centered on board directors, board candidates, governance, or board education.
